steps: Peel and roughly chop 3 peaches, then place them in a small saucepan over medium heat.
Add lemon juice and cook for 8 to 10 minutes, stirring often, until the peaches are very soft and jammy.
Remove from heat and mash the cooked peach with a fork into a smooth compote.
Stir chia seeds into the warm peach compote and let the mixture rest for 5 minutes to thicken.
In a medium bowl, stir vanilla into plain yogurt until combined.
Spoon the yogurt into 4 small cups or jars, filling each about halfway.
Top each cup with an even layer of peach chia compote.
Serve immediately, or refrigerate for up to 2 days; stir before serving if the layers have settled.
